Hanuš2016 Table2 reports24 dense lightcurves across four apparitions plus485 sparse points and one pole. This published shape is selected; no independent physical-volume calibration is in its archive record. The thermal scale is approximate. Convex inversion supplies broad outline without resolved craters, concavities, reflectance or regolith texture.
